ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 70% high-intensity white pixels against 30% low-intensity black perimeter pixels on the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central contiguous high-intensity white field across both lobes. Continuous low-intensity black pigmentation band along the trailing edge. Distinct black pixel mottling clusters located near the central peduncle junction and along the lower trailing edge of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped median notch; interior angle approximately 45-50 degrees; depth is roughly 15% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration with pixel-amplitude variations of 3-7 pixels along the continuous trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory along the central trailing edge transitioning to an upward-tapering concave curve at the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme distal tips of both lobes; highest density on the right lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple thin, dark, non-parallel linear pixel disruptions on the white ventral surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive clusters of calcified parasitic organisms (barnacles) on the lobe tips causing structural surface irregularities.
